name: Appartement Schöpf
beschreibung: Appartement Schöpf is located in Sölden in the Ötztal Valley. The holiday apartment is tailored for self-catering stays. Amenities include a fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom, and two bedrooms. Situated in a residential area, it offers a pleasantly peaceful setting. The valley stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable cars are nearby, providing easy access to activities in both winter and summer. Free on-site parking is available at the property.
